rubrics.justification: Core description is broadly consistent with a 3AA expanded blastocyst, including zona thinning and strong ICM/TE, but it adds several image-specific caveats (vacuoles, debris, inclusions, irregular architecture) that may be over-interpreted or not clearly verifiable from a single embryo image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor, smoking, endometrium, cycle history, and transfer timing with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear link from embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis, though the numerical probability adjustments appear somewhat subjective and may over-penalize some factors.

Generally consistent with Gardner grading and standard IVF practice, especially regarding embryo quality, smoking counseling, and transfer planning, but some recommendations (ERA/EMMA/ALICE, thrombophilia testing, embryo glue emphasis) are more selective and not routine first-line guideline-based steps.

Provides clear, practical next steps for the current transfer and contingency planning for future cycles, including lifestyle modification, luteal support review, and escalation options if failure occurs.
